messages.content: Tell a tiny original fable or playful imagined scene with a clear event and point, shaped by this character's disposition. Each sentence must start Imagine or In this tale, so it is explicitly invented fiction, never actual history, biography, memory or world state. Do not retell an earlier reply. One or two short complete sentences; return speech JSON only. In your reply I means the named character; you means the addressed listener. Player claims and reports are attributed, not verified facts. Do not invent real biography, stock, money, weather, secrets, purchases, promises or completed actions. No tools. Application labels are not people.

[player_2 -> keeper] Tell me a story.
